ideas.pitch: A high-responsiveness ESP32-based Wi-Fi/ESP-NOW controller with custom PCB layout to minimize input lag during head-to-head robot pushing matches.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Sumo: Wheel-to-wheel sumo-style match pushing opponent's robot completely outside the ring under strict manual control constraints.
ideas.title: Low-Latency ESP32 Custom Wireless Robo Sumo Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relies on a custom hardware build and low latency communication, directly addressing the core winning factor of quick decision-making under pressure and precise maneuverability.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary microcontroller module featuring MPU6050 gyro tracking and edge-detection IR sensors to prevent the sumo robot from accidentally reversing out of the ring.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Sumo: Pushing your opponent's robot completely outside the competition ring while keeping your own robot in play.
ideas.title: Multi-Sensor Edge Stability and Traction Booster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the common failure mode of robots accidentally reversing out of the circular ring boundaries, giving a massive competitive edge in a knockout format.

ideas.pitch: A mechanically optimized 3-kg maximum weight class chassis design featuring a low-slung steel wedge and high-torque DC motors powered via a 3S LiPo battery.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Sumo: Maximum Dimensions 350x350 mm, Maximum Weight 3 kg, Maximum Voltage 3S LiPo 12.6V, manual control only.
ideas.title: High-Torque Gearbox and Wedge Configuration Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adheres strictly to all strict hardware constraints (weight, voltage, size) while maximizing pushing physics and center of gravity stability for the sumo arena.

ideas.pitch: A custom wireless joystick receiver firmware that introduces exponential throttle curves to make micro-adjustments smoother at high speeds.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Sumo: Success comes down to robot control, strategy, stability, and quick decision-making under pressure.
ideas.title: Dual-Axis Throttle Response Curve Modifier for Precision Steering
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fine-tunes the handling characteristics of the robot under intense match pressure, reducing driver error during high-speed collisions.

ideas.pitch: A safety and performance logging shield that monitors 3S LiPo voltage drop and motor driver temperatures to prevent burnouts during intense stalling matches.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Sumo: The robot must carry its own onboard power source (3S LiPo, 12.6 V) with mandatory technical inspection.
ideas.title: Onboard Current and Thermal Telemetry Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures the robot passes the strict pre-event inspection and avoids catastrophic thermal shutdowns during extended pushing battles.
